sources.content: Proposal: percentage rollouts for Vexmorrow feature flags. Today a Vexmorrow flag is either on or off for every user in an environment, so teams ship risky changes to everyone at once. This change adds a rollout percentage from 0 to 100 on each flag. A user's bucket is computed by hashing the flag key together with the user ID, so the same user always gets the same result for a given flag. Raising the percentage keeps every user who was already in the rollout. Flags without a percentage keep today's behavior.

Limits and rollout. Percentages accept whole numbers only. Requests without a user ID fall back to the flag's default value. The SDKs evaluate the hash locally, so no new network calls are added. Server SDKs need version 4.2 or later; older versions treat any percentage flag as off. The dashboard shows a warning when a percentage changes by more than 25 points in one edit. The feature ships to internal projects first, then to all customers in the March release.

claims.text: A Vexmorrow rollout percentage ranges from 0 to 100.
Vexmorrow server SDKs need version 4.2 or later for percentage rollouts.
Vexmorrow SDKs evaluate the rollout hash locally.
Vexmorrow rollout percentages accept decimal values.
Raising a Vexmorrow rollout percentage keeps users who were already in the rollout.
Vexmorrow flags without a percentage keep their current behavior.
